newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks rocket, most blue-chips limit up.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks rocket, most blue-chips limit up.

text.p: A frantic scramble for Thai equities continued through the morning session on Thursday following the baht's de facto devaluation on Wednesday.
With many stocks up their daily 10 percent limit, or lacking sellers, frustrated investors were scouring the market for stocks to buy, traders said.
"There is still heavy demand for blue chips which have hit limit up, especially banking issues. So investors wanting to buy these can't do anything," said a broker at Securities One.
By 0425 GMT the composite SET index was 617.04, up 48.25 points or 8.48 percent, in 3.2 billion baht turnover.
